app.notes:
The karaoke screen keeps its size when the keyboard opens, in portrait and landscape
While you type a search, the song list stays visible above the keyboard
The number keys stay big in landscape
Hold the keypad's erase key to clear the whole search or code at once
Search boxes have an X button that clears them in one tap
In landscape, the player buttons now start hidden, with a tab on the side to bring them out
Holding the erase key on your phone's keyboard clears the whole search
New lyrics editor: from a song's menu, write or paste the words, tap along as the song plays to time each line, nudge any line, and save
An LRC file beside a MIDI song now gives it its words, and the MIDI still scores your singing. Song bank songs can have one too, named by their code
TV remote: Right on the stage brings out the hidden keypad, and Back puts it away
TV remote: sliders now move with Left and Right, so Down always reaches Done
TV remote: press OK on an equalizer bar to adjust it, and OK again to finish
